explanation: W = 1.45 GeV is below the p + eta production threshold for ep -> e'p eta. This EXCLURAD eta configuration uses m_p = 0.938272 GeV and m_eta = 0.54786 GeV (exclurad.F, DATA amhad/amunm/amp statements), giving a threshold of W_th = m_p + m_eta = 1.486132 GeV. At W = 1.45 GeV (about 0.036 GeV below threshold) there is no physical phase space for the recoiling p-eta system, so no real Born cross section or radiative correction exists at this kinematic point regardless of Q^2, cos(theta*), or phi*. I confirmed this empirically: building an input.dat with these exact kinematics (model=3/maid2000, ivec=1, bmom=6.53, vcut=0.166) and running ./eta/build/exclurad on it did not error out cleanly but instead hung indefinitely at ~99% CPU with all output files (all.dat, allu.dat, radasm.dat, radcor.dat, radsigmi.dat, radsigpl.dat, radtot.dat) staying empty; the process had to be killed manually after ~1 minute rather than producing a number. No valid delta or sigma_born can be reported. To get a result, W must be increased to at least ~1.487 GeV (the code's own example/scan grids start at W = 1.487 GeV for exactly this reason).
